what: Hand-drawn plot boundaries. Ground truth for find_plot_in_plan.
how_to_read: vertices_page are ordered [x,y] in ORIGINAL page pixels, same frame as the pipeline's vertices_page, so IoU against a traced ring is direct. status: drawn | no_boundary (nothing enclosing is drawn on the page) | unusable (not a usable plan) | skip. saw_ai_ring records whether the pipeline overlay was revealed before finishing.

labels.note: Originally labelled no_boundary. On review the page DOES carry a drawn boundary and v2 found it: accurate.

revision: 2026-09-04: four pages first labelled no_boundary were reviewed against v2's output and corrected to drawn. Two rings were judged accurate, two right-plot-but-loose. Their vertices come from v2, not from hand drawing -- see ring_source. This means the label set itself had a 4/62 error rate, all in one direction: 'I cannot find a boundary' is a weaker judgement than 'here is the boundary'.
